officialUserPrompt: Here is the actual prompt: Create a VPC with private subnets. Create 2 of the newest AWS Linux 2 EC2 instances in the private subnet mounting an EFS file system for shared storage.
answer: This Terraform configuration creates an AWS VPC with public and private subnets across two Availability Zones. It provisions a NAT Gateway so private EC2 instances can install packages during boot while remaining inaccessible from the public internet. It creates an Amazon EFS file system with mount targets in the private subnets, then launches two of the newest Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instances in those private subnets. Each instance mounts the shared EFS file system at `/mnt/efs`.
